answer: Because the vine weight is recomputed from the fable history each close, the atlas audit makes public the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 5 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 36% of full weight. That is 36 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
